messages:
deploy-bot: PROD deploy started — tag `v3.6.0` (commit `4c7b9d`). Initiated by @sana. Plan: greenflip rollout 5% -> 30% -> 100% across regions (us-east-1, us-west-2). Change window until 21:00 UTC. Rollback policy: auto-fallback on >=3% error rate. Command: ```deploy promote --env prod --tag v3.6.0```

sana: kicking off canary now. dashboards: https://dash.internal/releases/v3.6.0 — I'll watch latency and errors.

deploy-bot: Canary 5% healthy after ~6m. Metrics: P95=120ms, error_rate=0.2%, qps stable. No anomalies.

james: quick q — are we pinning the serving model for this rollout? want to avoid cross-variant noise.

release-eng: confirmed — manifest updated to `model_pin: redwood-model-v2.1.3-quant`. Pin pushed to canary and will remain for full rollout.

deploy-bot: Promoting to 30% now (greenflip step 2).

oncall-bot: ALERT: inference-timeout spike in us-west-2 +1.6% above baseline (18 new timeouts) — see logs: https://logs.app/queries/abc123

sana: pausing at 30% while we investigate the timeout spike. @miko can you triage logs and redis metrics?

miko: on it — seeing short redis latency blips coincident with the timeouts. Warming KV cache and bumping connection pool. Will validate request retry behavior.

miko: after warming cache, test traffic looks clean. Recommend resume rollout in 10m if no further spikes.

sana: agreed, resuming.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 100% now. Finalizing cutover.

deploy-bot: PROD deploy complete — tag `v3.6.0` (commit `4c7b9d`). Completed at ts 1978001289. Status: SUCCESS. Duration: ~42m. Final metrics: P95=125ms, error_rate=0.25%. No rollback performed.

miko: :shipit: Nice job.

sana: thanks all — will open a short post-release note with the perf numbers and the redis blip mitigation steps.
